videos.title: Kapustin — EM duality and geometric Langlands

units.title: Classical electric–magnetic duality
units.summary: Starts from Maxwell: in vacuum, symmetry mapping magnetic field to minus electric field and electric to magnetic; seed of S-duality.

units.title: Wilson lines (electric) and dual magnetic defects
units.summary: Wilson loops encode insertion of electric charge worldlines; dual magnetic line operators / Hooft-type defects are the dual observables—central to matching dualities with Langlands dual group.

units.title: EM duality related to geometric Langlands
units.summary: Pedagogical bridge: electromagnetic duality and defects reappear in a form that organizes geometric Langlands (gauge theory on a surface / Hitchin-related geometry); physics dictionary, not a full math proof.

units.title: Why geometric Langlands is interesting
units.summary: Motivates geometric Langlands as a meeting point of number theory (classical Langlands), geometry, and representation theory—before physics half of the talk.

units.title: Physics approach to geometric Langlands
units.summary: Second half: physics introduction / approach via S-duality of N=4-type gauge theory; dual group G∨; distinguishes physics interpretation from pure mathematical formulations.

units.title: Geometry of varieties ↔ representations
units.summary: Theme of geometric representation theory: representations of G realized by geometric objects on varieties; geometric Langlands is a high-end instance of this philosophy.

videos.title: Frenkel — Gauge Theory, Geometric Langlands, and All That

units.title: Orientation on gauge theory ↔ geometric Langlands
units.summary: Expository orientation connecting gauge-theoretic dualities to geometric Langlands; use for culture when Kapustin/Gukov are heavy.
